extDesc.message: Automatically shows overflowing bookmarks in extra rows below the bookmarks bar.

barColorDesc.message: Text color adjusts to the background automatically. Reset returns to the default light/dark colors.

boundaryOffsetDesc.message: Reserve adjustment in px (+ = start earlier)

hoverCloseDelayDesc.message: ms until a hovered folder closes (0 - 2000)

displayBehaviorDesc.message: Auto-hide never alters the page. Push may break some sites.

revealEdgeDesc.message: Show when cursor is within N px of the top (1 - 50)

ntpModeDesc.message: Custom shows the multi-row bar on new tabs

ntpNotice.message: Chrome will ask once whether to keep the new tab change. Choose "Keep it" to continue using this page — "Restore settings" disables the extension. You can switch back to Chrome's default new tab anytime via the extension icon → Settings → New tab page.

pushWarning.message: Note: Push mode may break layout on some sites (fixed headers, 100vh layouts).

fontSizeInfo.message: Text size of the extension bar items (8 - 20px).

rowHeightInfo.message: Height of each extension bar row (20 - 60px).

maxRowsInfo.message: Maximum number of extension rows. 0 = unlimited.

folderOpenInfo.message: Open folder dropdowns by hovering or by clicking.

barModeInfo.message: "Overflow only" continues from the bookmarks hidden behind the native bar. "All bookmarks" renders everything in the extension bar.

boundaryInfo.message: Corrects the estimate of how many bookmarks fit in the native bar. If the first extension item is duplicated or missing, adjust with the arrows. Stored in px, so it stays valid after reordering.

revealDelayInfo.message: Wait time after touching the top edge before the bar appears. Increase to avoid accidental reveals (0 - 1000ms).

hideOnClickInfo.message: Collapse the bar immediately after opening a bookmark from it.

hideOnOutsideClickInfo.message: Collapse the bar immediately when clicking anywhere outside it.

languageInfo.message: UI language of the extension. 'Match browser' follows Chrome's display language.
